item.title: Storm damage, stalled grant threaten historic Black cemetery in Buncombe County
item.description: After Tropical Storm Helene toppled trees across a historic African American cemetery at Alexander Chapel United Methodist Church, plans to clear and restore the site have stalled. A promised $30,000 federal grant remains in limbo, leaving damaged, largely unmarked graves unrestored.
